purpose: Reviewed evidence required before a module may advance its official maturity state. References identify runbooks, tests or immutable evidence; they never contain secrets or personal data.

experimental.permissions: module catalog featureFlag/enforcement and domain authorization contract
experimental.tests: module testCommands declared in the technical catalog
experimental.featureFlag: disabled-by-default or not-applicable flag explicitly declared
experimental.fallback: fallback and rollback fields declared in the technical catalog
